summary: Implemented the PatchIter / GridPatchDataset feature in the repository. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch, coordinates) pairs with a docstring Note on the coordinate format; set_rnd skips keys starting with "__"), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter callable; GridPatchDataset rewritten to take dataset, patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates; NumPy ceil for worker split; PatchDataset float alias fixed), monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc entry), and a new tests/test_grid_dataset.py with test_shape, test_loading_array and test_missing_length. Nothing was run, per instructions, so the pinned test values are unverified; run pytest tests/test_grid_dataset.py to confirm. Choices: the missing-length NotImplementedError is raised at iteration start rather than in the constructor; I added test_missing_length beyond the required two tests. Lines 232-234 of utils.py were already over 120 characters before this change and were left alone. Nothing is committed.
